title: ESTRA / EA-OC-EXTENSION v1.0.0 — Reference Artefacts (Public Release)
description: This record contains the v1.0.0 public release of the ESTRA / EA-OC-EXTENSION project. The release consists of a fixed set of reference artefacts intended for inspection, classification, and scholarly citation. The material documents a structural and epistemic construct describing system states, constraints, and transitions. It is provided as a frozen snapshot of documents and sources, without claims of applicability, effectiveness, or operational use.
